subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should external plugin-owned session catalogs become a permanent generic Gateway and Plugin SDK surface that appears in the native session UX whenever the owning plugin is active?
rationale: Fixing the concrete pagination defect does not settle the new public plugin contract, removal of provider-specific surfaces, or the change from opt-in supervision to default operator catalog visibility.

options.title: Adopt generic catalog
options.body: Approve the direction after the pagination defect, compatibility review, conflicts, and upgrade proof are resolved.

options.title: Narrow to pagination
options.body: Retain provider-specific catalog surfaces and limit this work to correcting bounded pagination.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the branch until external-session ownership and continuation semantics are narrowed.

recommendation.title: Adopt generic catalog
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after the pagination defect, compatibility review, conflicts, and upgrade proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The concentrated recent history and linked feature authorship across the affected product and code surfaces make Peter Steinberger the strongest available decision owner.
